title: Humanoids Market Worth $200BN By 2035: Barclays' Todorova
summary:
The market for AI-powered robots and autonomous machines has the potential to balloon into a trillion-dollar opportunity by 2035 in the 'decade of the robot', according to Barclays analyst Zornitsa Todorova.
AI-enabled robotics mark a frontier moment in the technology and present a new set of investment opportunities in a world of labor shortages and changing worker preferences.
She spoke to Tom Mackenzie on the latest episode of Bloomberg Tech: Europe. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Robeauté Bets on Rice-Sized Microrobots for Brain Disease
summary:
The CEO of French neurotechnology startup Robeauté says its microrobot could unlock precise delivery of drugs and other therapies directly into the brain, 
The microrobots, which are each the size of grain of rice, are able to reach areas that are difficult to access with existing treatments.
Joana Cartocci says the company is targeting first-in-human studies in 2027 and a market launch in the early 2030s.
She spoke to Tom Mackenzie on the latest episode of Bloomberg Tech: Europe. (Source: Bloomberg)
